z_order_note: 1:1 with BenchScene: back butterflies sit above the ground shadow but under the body. If the static bench is shipped as ONE merged image, put back video under it (back butterflies are then also under the ground shadow - small look change).
display: both videos: position absolute, same box, object-fit: fill (mod-16 non-uniform resample undone on screen); NOT inside the settle transform wrapper (track positions are page coords, not moved by the bench rise)
decode: stacked alpha: top = premultiplied RGB, bottom = alpha; shader a = clamp((A-.006)/.988) * uvEdge(smoothstep(0,.015)), rgb = min(rgb, a)

timing.play: once, both layers started together on the same clock; on ended -> hide/remove both videos (last frame is fully transparent)
